choice.basis: The chart 'Month vs. Number of samples tested' displays a y-axis labeled 'Count' with an inverted scale where 0.0 is at the top and 1.2 is at the bottom (multiplied by 1e6). The data series begins at the leftmost point (Nov 20) near the bottom of the chart, corresponding to a count of approximately 1.2e6. As the series progresses to the rightmost point (Jun 26), the line moves upward on the screen to a position near the top, corresponding to a count of approximately 0.4e6. Because the axis is inverted, the upward visual movement represents a decrease in the numeric value (from 1.2 million to 0.4 million samples). This indicates a declining volume pattern over the reporting window. The task requires routing to the operational follow-up matching this pattern, which corresponds to the 'declining-volume outreach review' option.
choice.option_label: Route the testing-volume record to declining-volume outreach review
